definitions.gloss: return gift; returning a courtesy; reciprocal gesture
definitions.explanation: Giving a gift or performing a courtesy in return for one received. An important part of Japanese gift-giving culture.

examples.japanese: {返礼|へんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼|へんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}ろう→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm trying to decide what to send as a return gift for the year-end present.

examples.japanese: ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特産物|とくさんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: You can receive local specialty products as return gifts for hometown tax donations.

notes:
USAGE:
{返礼|へんれい} refers to the act of reciprocating a gift or courtesy. In Japanese culture, receiving a gift creates a social obligation to give something in return. The word is also widely used in the context of ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧ (hometown tax), where municipalities send {返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん} (return gifts) to donors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}: return gift item
- {返礼|へんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧: gift given in return
- {返礼|へんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to send a return gift
- ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}: hometown tax return gift
